login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your team inbox
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an admin to reset it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.welcome: Welcome, {{name}}. Please replace your temporary password.
changePassword.sameAsOld: Must differ from the current password.

setup.title: Welcome to EzyChat Lite
setup.subtitle: Let's get your shared inbox running.

admin.forbiddenTitle: Setup must be done on this computer
admin.forbiddenBody: For security, the first admin can only be created from the computer running EzyChat Lite. Open http://localhost:7420 there.
admin.usernameRule: 3–32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash, underscore.
admin.displayNameHint: Shown to teammates next to your replies.
admin.introShort: Create your admin account. You can add teammates later.
admin.businessNameHint: Used to prepare your AI assistant’s business info.
admin.usernameAutoHint: You sign in with this. Filled in from your name; you can change it.

wa.title: Link your WhatsApp number
wa.relinkHint: Generate a new QR code to link this number.
wa.step1: Open WhatsApp on the phone with the business number.
wa.step2: Go to Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
wa.step3: Scan this QR code — or use the Phone number tab to link with a code instead.
wa.disclaimer: EzyChat Lite is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Unofficial clients can get numbers banned — avoid bulk messaging.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: It answers common customer questions on WhatsApp from what you write below, and hands the chat to your team when it can’t help.
ai.template:
{{business}}
Opening hours: 
Products & prices: 
Delivery: 
How to order:
ai.businessHint: Opening hours, products and prices, delivery and how to order. You can change this any time.
ai.turnOn: Turn on the AI assistant now
ai.turnOnHint: It starts answering new customer messages. You can turn it off any time.
ai.offUntilConnected: The AI stays off until it is connected. Finish still saves your business info.
ai.needText: Fill in a few details about your business first, or choose Skip for now.
ai.saveFailed: The AI assistant could not be saved. Try again.

ready.title: Your inbox is ready
ready.waNotLinked: WhatsApp not linked yet. Link it under Admin → WhatsApp.
ready.aiOff: AI assistant is off. Set it up any time from the inbox.
ready.phoneAccess: Use on phones outside this Wi-Fi
